description: App-command grants for the pre-authentication `login` window: identity list/create/delete, login itself, the commit and cancel of the delete's review (its passphrase proof), avatar lookup for the identity picker, opening the buddy list on success, the lifecycle snapshot, and its event stream (which carries only lifecycle transitions), and the report of a device skin it could not apply (`report_skin_apply_failed`, plan SK2-T1: the window reports, the Host decides). Deliberately excludes every other command — this window is reachable before any identity/session exists.
